title: In California this weekend …
excerpt: At Neighborhood Church (Palos Verdes Estates, 7 pm Saturday), at All Saints Episcopal (Pasadena, 10:15 am Forum, Sunday), at Christ Our Redeemer AME (3:30 pm Sunday, Irvine), and at Claremont School of Theology (registration for this one is closed). Hope to see many of you there!
